title: LADA Blue Wings vs Disco Bandoleros, Sep 13
notes: Home game at Snoqualmie A (the 3840x1536 strip camera, rink snoqualmie): we wore white and had the left bench, which the pipeline mapped for this game.

Periods, goals and shots come from the arena scoreboard (we were HOME): periods 0:09-18:30, 20:32-38:35 and 40:10-64:14 of the video, by the clock. The video runs to the final horn. Goals at 13:34 (ours), 23:31 and 55:42 (Disco Bandoleros) of the video. Shots on goal: Blue Wings 19, Disco Bandoleros 38. No penalties: neither penalty panel lit up.
Played: the 13 skaters of LADA's lineup. Didn't play: Skitsko #16, Trunov #35, Tverskoy #44, Dukhno #50. No spares. Horokh #77 is spelled as on his jersey (Goroh on SportNinja).

Three short stretches in the 3rd show 4 of us on the ice: 46:30-46:48 is a slow line change, and Lisenko #55 stepped on about 15 s before his shift here starts (47:04); 49:24-49:46 is a timeout with both teams at their benches; at 55:10-55:30 Lisenko #55 was still on the ice until about 55:34, so his last shift before the 1-2 goal is about 20 s short.

highlights.note: Scramble at their net with the goalie down: 1-0
Scramble at our net three minutes into the 2nd ties it 1-1
Disco Bandoleros go ahead from a scramble at our net with 6:49 left: 1-2
